messages:
marcos: Quick sync — proposing kickoff with VaultCorp and OneLogin for an on-prem SSO + HSM POC. Goal: SCIM provisioning + SAML SSO, and KMS/HSM key-wrapping for secrets. Proposed dates: next Tue or Thu. Agenda: 1) auth flow, 2) key provisioning, 3) audit/retention, 4) roll-out plan. Who's in?

priya: I'm in. Need to decide SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated — would like both supported if feasible. Also SCIM attrs: displayName, email, employeeNumber by default.

alex: Eng can do SP + IdP. Q: for HSM key provisioning do we expect automated PKCS#11 provisioning or customer-provided key material (BYOK)? Automated will add ~3-4w dev plus rotation automation.

sophie: From security: prefer customer-managed keys in HSM (BYOK) for enterprise / regulated customers. Also need attestation evidence + immutable rotation logs for audits.

marcos: @liz_vaultcorp can you confirm VaultCorp constraints on KMS integration? Any preferred flow (PKCS#11 vs REST wrap)?

liz_vaultcorp: liz_vaultcorp: We can support both, but most customers use our REST keywrap endpoint for simplicity. PKCS#11 is supported for on-prem appliances but heavier to operate. I'll attach the API spec and our security whitepaper.

marcos: Can you share a sample cURL for the wrap API so engineering can prototype?

liz_vaultcorp: sure —
```
curl -X POST https://vaultcorp.example.com/api/v1/wrap \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"key_id":"proj-123","plaintext":"BASE64(...)"}'
```

alex: For SCIM sync we need attribute mapping and group sync policy. Recommend incremental SCIM sync every 5m with a bulk reconciliation daily.

priya: Also confirm how we handle contractor/contingent worker accounts — add externalId and userType to mapping and a flag to exclude from certain routes.

sophie: Add audit events for key operations and SCIM provisioning changes to our event bus. Is 90d retention okay or do we need longer for legal/regulatory?

marcos: Action items: 1) @liz_vaultcorp send KMS API spec + SLA + whitepaper by EOD Fri. 2) @alex prototype wrap/unwrap against their REST endpoint (target: 2w). 3) @priya finalize SCIM attribute map (this week). 4) @sophie confirm retention reqs with legal. I'll book the joint call — proposing Tue 10am PT. Ack with :thumbsup:?

liz_vaultcorp: ack — will send spec and whitepaper. :white_check_mark:

alex: ack, will start prototype tomorrow.

priya: ack. Ping me if spec missing by Thu.

sophie: ack — looping in legal.

deploybot: Reminder: onboarding-docs template created at https://redwood-internal.example.com/docs/partnerships/vaultcorp-onprem (auto message)

marcos: Thanks everyone — I'll send calendar invite and attach an architecture diagram + minimal PoC checklist (auth flow, keywrap demo, SCIM mapping).

liz_vaultcorp: thanks, see you Tue.
